enable_service.description: Enable the Bluetooth daemon at system startup.

device_name.description: Human-readable name of the Bluetooth adapter, shown during device discovery.

short_name.description: Short name (≤ 8 chars) used in BLE advertising and GATT discovery.

discoverable_timeout.description: Seconds until the adapter stops being discoverable (0 = always discoverable). Set to 30–60 for desktops/laptops.

pairing_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a pairing operation to complete before timing out.

page_timeout.description: Maximum time (in 0.625ms units) to wait for a page response during inquiry. Higher values improve reliability for distant devices.

inquiry_scan_interval.description: Interval (in 0.625ms units) between inquiry scans. Lower = more responsive, higher power use.

inquiry_scan_window.description: Duration (in 0.625ms units) of each inquiry scan. Usually equal to scan interval.

page_scan_interval.description: Interval (in 0.625ms units) between page scans for connecting to known devices.

page_scan_window.description: Duration (in 0.625ms units) of each page scan. Typically equals scan interval.

device_class.description: Bluetooth device class (major/minor/service) indicating device type and capabilities.

supported_services.description: List of Bluetooth service classes to advertise (e.g., 'SerialPort', 'Handsfree', 'Headset'). Leave empty for none.

auto_enable.description: Bluetooth profiles/services to auto-enable when the adapter starts.

le_supported.description: Enable Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) support on this adapter.

le_advertising_interval_min.description: Minimum LE advertising interval (in 0.625ms units). Lower = faster discovery, higher power.

le_advertising_interval_max.description: Maximum LE advertising interval (in 0.625ms units). Usually equal to min for constant advertising.

max_connected.description: Maximum number of simultaneous active connections (e.g., headsets, keyboards).

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to help diagnose issues.

adapter_data_paths.description: List of per-adapter storage paths for pairing data (used in multi-adapter systems).

path.description: Absolute or relative path for this adapter’s pairing/trust data.

legacy_pairing.description: Enable legacy (non-secure) pairing for compatibility with older devices.

mitm_protection.description: Require Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) protection (e.g., passkey entry) for pairing. Enable for security-critical devices.

secure_simple_pairing.description: Enforce Secure Simple Pairing (SSP). Recommended for all modern devices.

justworks_repairing.description: Allow 'Just Works' (no user interaction) pairing. Disable for security-sensitive environments.

gatt_primary_service.description: Expose BLE GATT server functionality system-wide (required for smart devices).

experimental.description: Enable experimental/unsafe features. Only use if required by hardware or specifications.

offload.description: Enable hardware offloading for BLE connections. Improves performance and battery life if supported.

hfp.description: Enable Hands-Free Profile (HFP) for hands-free headsets and car kits.

a2dp.description: Enable Advanced Audio Distribution Profile (A2DP) for high-quality stereo audio streaming.

avdtp.description: Enable AVDTP — required for A2DP streaming.

codecs.description: List of audio codecs to enable, in format '<codec>:<enabled>' (e.g., 'aptX:1 ldac:1').

sink_latency.description: Target audio latency (in ms) for A2DP sinks. 0 = automatic tuning. Range: 0–1000.

media.description: Enable remote media control (play/pause/next/prev via headset buttons).

media_backend.description: Backend for media control (e.g., 'bluez', 'mpris'). 'bluez' integrates with BlueZ; 'mpris' uses system media controls.

a2dp_endpoints.description: Maximum concurrent A2DP sources or sinks (e.g., multiple speakers/headsets).
